title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 04:12:53 最新章节：第3279章 电话沟通误会
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
云仓城，秦氏府邸，宴客殿。
秦氏家主秦天雄正坐上首。
诸多族人坐在右侧。
左侧列坐的则是如今云仓城第一家族姜家众人。
众人正觥筹交错，把酒言欢。
忽然。
“秦伏天！下个月，天剑门要在云仓城招纳新晋弟子，你可有把握入天剑门？”
姜家众人当中，一身着锦绣长裙的少女站起身来。
少女名为姜云岚，明媚皓齿，容貌清绝，集美貌与天赋一身，加之姜府千金的身份，令无数年少俊杰神往和疯狂。
随着姜云岚这么一开口。
原本喧闹的宴客殿顿时在这一瞬瞬间安静下来。
一道道目光，皆是落在少女对面一名白衣少年身上。
白衣少年身材颀长清瘦，容貌俊逸，身上透露出一股若有若无的出尘气息。
他便是当今秦家少主秦伏天！
闻言，秦伏天原本微阖的双目缓缓睁开，看向对面少女，淡淡回应：“应该有些把握……”
“呵呵。”姜云岚嗤笑一声，“到了此时，你还要装腔作势？现在整个云仓城都知道，你秦伏天已经丹田破碎，沦为一个废人。
一个废人，如何通过天剑门的考核？
不妨再告诉你，秦伏天！我已经被天剑门的内门长老看中，很快就会成为天剑门的内门弟子。现在的我，你已经配不上了，明白么？”
“沦为废人，配不上你？”秦伏天心里不由得冷笑。
没错，在上一次为家族争夺资源的大战之中，秦伏天丹田破碎，修为尽废。

甚至——没有人知道……那一战，秦伏天不仅仅丹田破碎，更是命断落凤山。
但也就是那一日，另一个秦伏天苏醒。
而这一个秦伏天，是已站在万界之巅亿万年之久的神帝至尊——伏天神帝。
一次机缘巧合，伏天神帝魂魄通过虚空乱流来到这个世界！
所以，姜云岚容貌再美又如何？天赋再好又如何？
前世身为掌控芸芸众生的绝颠神帝，秦伏天见过的神女何其之多？
他麾下任何一个神女，放在这个世界，都是绝顶天资，都有着足以惑乱众生的倾世妖颜。
一个姜云岚，又岂能入得了秦伏天的法眼？
而此时，这姜云岚却在秦伏天的面前说，他已是配不上她姜云岚，这是何其可笑？
“所以，你是什么意思？”
秦伏天淡漠地瞥了姜云岚一眼。
“若是你有一点自知之明，就应当主动将婚书拿出来，当着所有人的面毁掉。”姜云岚冷声道。
“哗！”
姜云岚此言一出，满座哗然。
不少秦氏族人，皆是神色愤然。
姜云岚当众悔婚，这不仅仅是对秦伏天赤裸裸的羞辱。
同样是将秦氏一族的脸踩在地上摩擦啊！
坐在上首的秦天雄亦是浓眉掀起，额头上的青筋都鼓突起来。
而这时，姜家家主姜震山也随之笑着站起身来。
content_en:
Yuncang City, the Qin family's residence, and the banquet hall.
Qin Tianxiong, the head of the Qin family, is sitting on the throne.
Many tribesmen are sitting on the right side.
Sitting on the left side are members of the Jiang family, now the number one family in Yuncang City.
Everyone was drinking and chatting among each other.
suddenly.
"Qin Futian! Next month, Tianjian Sect will recruit new disciples in Yuncang City. Are you sure about joining Tianjian Sect?"
Among the Jiang family members, a girl in a brocade dress stood up.
The girl's name is Jiang Yunlan. She has bright white teeth and a pure appearance. Her combination of beauty and talent, coupled with her status as the daughter of the Jiang family, makes countless young heroes fascinated and crazy.
As Jiang Yunlan spoke.
The originally noisy banquet hall suddenly became quiet at this moment.
All eyes fell on a young man in white opposite the girl.
The young man in white is tall and thin, with a handsome appearance, and his body exudes a vague aura of being from another world.
He is Qin Futian, the current young master of the Qin family!
Hearing this, Qin Futian slowly opened his slightly closed eyes, looked at the girl opposite, and responded lightly: "I should be somewhat sure..."
"Haha." Jiang Yunlan sneered, "At this point, you still want to show off? Now the entire Yuncang City knows that your Qin Futian has been shattered and reduced to a useless person.
How can a useless person pass the test of Tianjian Sect?
I might as well tell you again, Qin Futian! I have been favored by the inner sect elders of Tianjian Sect, and I will soon become an inner sect disciple of Tianjian Sect. You are no longer worthy of me now, do you understand? "
"I am reduced to a useless person, not worthy of you?" Qin Futian couldn't help but sneer in his heart.
That's right, in the last battle to compete for resources for the family, Qin Futian's dantian was shattered and his cultivation was completely ruined.
No one even knows... In that battle, Qin Futian not only had his Dantian shattered, but his life was cut off from Fengshan Mountain.
But that day, another Qin Futian woke up.
And this Qin Futian is the Supreme God Emperor who has stood at the top of all worlds for hundreds of millions of years—God Emperor Futian.
By chance, the soul of God Emperor Futian came to this world through the turbulent flow of the void!
So, no matter how beautiful Jiang Yunlan is, what does it matter? So what if your talent is great?
As the supreme divine emperor who controlled all living beings in his previous life, Qin Futian had seen so many goddesses?
Any of the goddesses under his command are extremely talented in this world, and they all have an alluring beauty that can confuse all living beings.
How could Jiang Yunlan stand in Qin Futian's eyes?
But at this time, Jiang Yunlan said in front of Qin Futian that he was no longer worthy of her, Jiang Yunlan. How ridiculous was this?
"So, what do you mean?"
Qin Futian glanced at Jiang Yunlan indifferently.
"If you had any self-awareness, you should take the initiative to take out the marriage document and destroy it in front of everyone." Jiang Yunlan said coldly.
"Wow!"
As soon as Jiang Yunlan said this, the whole audience was in an uproar.
Many members of the Qin clan looked angry.
Jiang Yunlan regretted her marriage in public, which was not only a naked humiliation to Qin Futian.
They also stepped on the faces of the Qin family and rubbed them on the ground!
Qin Tianxiong, who was sitting at the top, also had thick eyebrows raised, and the veins on his forehead were bulging.
At this time, Jiang Zhenshan, the head of the Jiang family, also stood up with a smile.
